messages:
neha_cs: FYI - Veridian is running a compliance pilot next week and requested temporary rate scaling + IP allowlist for two frontends. They specifically asked for routing to apac-edge only. Can infra ops support a staged increase?

 tom_ops: What are the exact IP ranges and proposed QPS? We should also check if this impacts existing regional capacity. :mag:

 neha_cs: Provided ranges:
 - 198.51.100.0/24
 - 2001:db8:abcd::/64
 They want 4x baseline (baseline ~40 qps each) to 160 qps for 48 hours, then drop to 80 qps for 7 days before fully reverting. Auto-revoke preferred.

 ryan_infra: That pattern (burst -> warm -> revert) is fine. We need a signed network access addendum and an internal tag for billing/renewal because theyre in talks about expanding to Dedicated.

 isabel_se: I'll prepare the infra config. Proposed YAML for playbook below. We should include an eval hook to capture tail-latency and token-cost deltas.
 ```yaml
 customer: veridian
 region: apac
 allowlist:
   - 198.51.100.0/24
   - 2001:db8:abcd::/64
 rate_plan:
   burst:
     qps: 160
     duration: 48h
   warm:
     qps: 80
     duration: 168h
   auto_revoke: true
 tags: [apac-pilot, renewal-opportunity, billing-flag]
```

 tom_ops: Security approval needed for IPv6 entry. @lisa_legal please confirm the addendum status and if we can apply now pending signature or must wait.

 lisa_legal: We have a draft addendum attached to the ticket. Legal can provisionally approve conditional on signed doc uploaded within 24h. Capture acknowledgement email from customer in the ticket.

 deploy-bot: Ticket created: https://app.redwood.ai/tickets/CS-8543 - infra will schedule change. ETA 3h for staging rollout.

 neha_cs: I'm asking Veridian to sign ASAP and will paste the confirmation here. Please don't roll to prod until we have the signature.

 ryan_infra: Staging change applied at 2026-04-02T09:18:04Z. Instrumentation: tenant.qps, tenant.latency_p95, tenant.token_cost.

 neha_cs: Customer confirmed and uploaded signed addendum at 2026-04-02T10:02:11Z. Go ahead for prod when ready.

 tom_ops: Proceeding with prod rollout. Noted: we'll tag metrics and set an alert for sustained >3x baseline for 2h and a cost-alert for projected overage.

 deploy-bot: Prod change applied at 2026-04-02T11:05:22Z. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/changes/CS-8543

 ryan_infra: Initial ramp: qps spiked to 172 for 3m then stabilized at ~150. p95 latency rose from 82ms -> 110ms during peak, back to 90ms after warm-phase. Billing flag set.

 isabel_se: Leaving note on renewal tracker: Veridian showing positive engagement, scheduled follow-up demo for Dedicated in 2 weeks. Capture pilot metrics for contract discussion.

 neha_cs: Great work team. Will close the loop with the customer and attach the pilot report once we have 48h + warm data. :sparkles:
